findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_fertilizer_products" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Lists the fertilizer product slugs this API tracks (anhydrous ammonia, urea, DAP, MAP, potash, liquid N 28/32, ATS, farm diesel, biodiesel) with display labels.…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
